sections.title: The letter cê
paragraphs: The letter (cê) /se/ has two sounds. Its main sound is the sound /k/, as in the word (casa) /ˈka.zɐ/, which means house.

sections.title: How to say cê
paragraphs: For the first sound, lift the back of your tongue to touch the roof of your mouth. Block the air, then release it sharply without voice. For the second sound, place the tip of your tongue near the ridge behind your upper teeth. Push air smoothly through the narrow gap. Put two fingers on your throat to feel that your voice stays quiet.

sections.title: Spelling rules for cê
paragraphs: The letter makes the sound /k/ before the vowels a, o, u, or before consonants, as in (corpo) /ˈkoɾ.pu/. The letter makes the sound /s/ before the vowels e or i, as in (cedo) /ˈse.du/ and (cidade) /si.ˈda.dɨ/.

sections.title: Mistakes to avoid with cê
paragraphs: Do not release a puff of air when you make the sound /k/ before vowels, like in the English word cat. Keep the burst very crisp and dry. Do not turn the sound /s/ before the vowel i into the soft sound in shoe. Keep it crisp, like the sound in sun.
